verdict.rationale: Solid's templates are JSX, and it is built on TypeScript (solid-gh-15, solid-gh-11). Its documented tsconfig sets `jsxImportSource: "solid-js"` (solid-gh-17), which implies Solid ships its own JSX typings, so the TypeScript compiler can check template markup the same way it checks script code. However, the evidence never explicitly describes type checking inside templates or how deep it goes. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that JSX templates are type-checked (props, events, attributes), details on the coverage of the typings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
